mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, which may potentiate glyburide's hypoglycemic effect through altered metabolism and increased insulin secretion, combined with potential sympathomimetic interactions that reduce glucose counterregulation.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely; consider alternative antidepressant or alternative antidiabetic agent; educate patient on hypoglycemia symptoms and ensure access to fast-acting carbohydrates.
